title: Weekly Roundup — 2026-10-26
headline: Defending champion keeps the DF95 world crown at Theewater
excerpt: The defending champion, Craig Richards, retained the title on 29 points — winning 7 of 11 qualifying races and 2 gold-fleet finals — ahead of Ulf Lindberg (45.4) and Odd Ornulf Stray (60). Also: Tour de Vlei; Ullman Sails Women's Series — Day 2; Dam Bottle Sprints. NW Youth Regionals Regatta 2026 is awaiting results.
